Enter the Thousand Maws of Toto[@1F]Rak?
It seems you are as ready as you will ever be. Very well. Enter now, and may the Twelve watch over you.
It is an admirable thing, wishing to help one's brethren. But if you are unsure of your mettle, perhaps it is best you not enter.
You are an adventurer, yes? I wonder, kupo...can you understand me? Are you hearing more than just incomprehensible kupo noises right now?
You are looking for your friends? How touching! You adventurers are all best friends forever, kupo!
Oooh, maybe this belongs to one of your friends, kupo? I found it deep, deep in the dungeon. But you mustn't go there! I saw Garleans! Garleans and more Garleans!
Your friends... I think perhaps they are... Well, they're dead, kupo.

I don't know what happened. One moment we were dancing in our flower fields, and the next we were here. That's when I noticed your friends, kupo. They must have seen the hidden entrance we used in the forest and followed us!

Anyway, it was then that I heard a strange voice, kupo. It sent a shiver right down my spine. Not long after that, we found this contraption here. Your friends started poking and picking at it, kupo. Maybe it was this strange device that brought us here... That called to us...
I pulled this bit off it, but now I've got a very, very bad feeling, kupo. Here, please take it far away from here. Far, far away!
Now, I'll just have a little nap and then be on my way. No need to worry about me, kupo.
Goodness gracious me! You look almost exactly like an adventurer I once met, adventurer. I wonder, kupo...can you understand me? Are you hearing more than just incomprehensible kupo noises right now?
I'll just have a little nap and be on my way. No need to worry about me, kupo. I'm feeling a bit better now, thanks to A[@1F]Ruhn.
He saved us! A[@1F]Ruhn saved us!
It was the voice. We couldn't resist it, kupo! A[@1F]Ruhn told us it was the crystals crying out.
Just what is this horrible contraption doing to the crystals?
So you have escaped the Maws with your life─no small feat, that. Tell me, what did you discover within?
Garleans... I see. And your missing friends? Ah. It is as I feared. I am sorry for Ul'dah's loss.

There is much to consider. The power of this mysterious voice, for example. For it to summon beasts is one thing─but moogles? And this magitek device...if it is indeed of Garlean making... What does it all mean? We must investigate further.

I will see that Nuala is informed of everything. I ask that you refrain from speaking of this to any of my countrymen. We must not let unconfirmed information disseminate amongst the people. That will only lead to panic.
On behalf of Gridania, I thank you. The information you have provided may prove crucial to understanding the Empire's plans for my nation, and Ul'dah as well.
I see... At the hands of imperials, you say? I am sorry. That is...most tragic.

But their death was not in vain. Both they and you have learned much of great value. This magitek device that appears to be of Garlean making, and its influence over the moogles... But what is the connection?

We must carry out further investigations if we are to understand all of this. Until we do, I must ask that you not let word of this spread to the masses. We cannot afford the panic. I will send word to Nuala myself.

I will see that Nuala is informed of everything that has happened. I ask that you refrain from speaking of this to any of my countrymen. We must not let unconfirmed information disseminate amongst the people. That will only lead to panic.
[@SPLIT([@STRING($EB(1))], ,1)]! It is good to see you in the Hall of Flames once more. Tell me, were you able to find our soldiers?
This bracer belongs to... No. Dead? All of them? But they were some of our most battle-hardened warriors! What evil could have done such a thing?
Garleans!?

I would not have thought the Gridanians capable of concealing information of such import. And now it has cost us the lives of many good men. Had we known, we may have pursued another course of action.
We will keep this bracer, in memory of our fallen. At least you have returned to us with your life. Thank the gods for that.

As for this [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000262,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000262,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)], you claim it to be part of a magitek device placed within the Maws by the Garleans? If so, then we must see it to the engineers of the Garlond Ironworks for inspection.
This bodes ill...all of it. Hordes of feral beasts, Garlean soldiers, a strange voice that unmans even moogles... Just what in the bloody hells is going on in that damnable dungeon!?

The Immortal Flames will not stand idly by. This is a time for action. And to act we must have information─such as the kind you have brought us this day. You have done well, [@SPLIT([@STRING($EB(1))], ,1)], and shall be rewarded.
Limsa Lominsa, too, must be informed of this. The three nations must devise a strategy together.
[@SPLIT([@STRING($EB(1))], ,1)], again you honor us with your visit. And again I have a task for you.

Many years ago, the Ishgardians undertook to build a mountain fortress in the central highlands of Coerthas. They called it the Dzemael Darkhold. Regretfully, we have learned that it has fallen under Garlean control.
As if that were not troubling enough, our scouts report seeing a high-ranking officer amongst the imperial forces stationed there─a man we believe to be the Legatus of the VIIth Legion.
In case you are unaware, the hold takes its name from House Dzemael, one of the four high houses of Ishgard. It was they who were responsible for its construction and subsequent defense...

Clearly, they were no match for the might of the Empire. But then who alone could claim to be? Perhaps it was this realization that drove them to put away their pride and take up arms with the other high houses. Together, they were able to retake the Darkhold's main gate.
Those come from the city are at Owl's Nest in the eastern lowlands of Coerthas. From there, they have sent messengers into the high mountains to deliver the call to arms.

When the call is answered, the army of House Fortemps will be flooded with unknown faces. Think of it─none will contest the presence of complete strangers. If ever there were a time to plant a spy to the north, that time is [@1A(1)]now[@1A(0)]! We must learn what we can of the Darkhold, and of Garlean operations in the area.

The Flames would send you, [@SPLIT([@STRING($EB(1))], ,1)]. Travel to Ishgard and take part in the attempt to reclaim Dzemael Darkhold. The commanding officer of House Fortemps's army is Ser Artoirel. You will first need to present yourself to him for duty.

For years now, Ishgard's gates have been closed to outsiders. Never have we seen such an opportunity to place one of our own in their midst, and we do not intend to let it pass by. If you will not serve us, we will find another who will.

Excellent. Then head north until you are among the knights, and look for the unicorn─the sigil of House Fortemps. Seek out this Ser Artoirel, and present him with this [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000265,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000265,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)].

But the structure is vast, and built around naturally occurring caves and tunnels. There are not men enough to secure all points of entry. And so another of the high houses, House Fortemps, has appealed to the knights of Ishgard's outer regions to join the fight.
Travel to Ishgard and take part in the attempt to reclaim Dzemael Darkhold. Learn whatever you can of what lies within, and of the Garleans who have seized control.

Knights of House Fortemps have been dispatched to Owl's Nest. Travel there and deliver this [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000265,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000265,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] to Ser Artoirel, their commanding officer.
You seek Ser Artoirel? On what business?

So you bear a [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000265,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000265,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)]. Are you the [@IF($E9(4),daughter,son)] of a swineherd, then? <sigh> It would seem our desperation knows no bounds. Well met, country bumpkin. You have the honor of speaking to Ser Vairemont of House Fortemps.
I cannot present you to Ser Artoirel because he is not here. He has ridden for the front with the main body of our force.

If you wish to distinguish yourself with service, hurry to the Darkhold in the central highlands. Show that [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000265,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,3,11000265,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)] of yours to the knights at the main gate. They will grant you entry.

But know this─the latest reports show that it is not only Garleans infesting the Darkhold. There are all manner of beasts and monsters roaming those halls, as well. The kind that take bumpkin sers for tasty morsels, hahaha!

Ahem. Storm the Darkhold with your brethren, and put down whatever imperials you encounter within. Return with proof of their demise, and you shall be generously rewarded─with more than you're like to see in a lifetime in Norwick, I should imagine.

To enter the Dzemael Darkhold, you must be in a party consisting of between [@IF($E5(4,0),[@IF($E2(4,10),[@SWITCH(4,one,two,three,four,five,six,seven,eight,nine,ten)],[@VALUE(4)])],[@VALUE(4)])] to [@IF($E5(8,0),[@IF($E2(8,10),[@SWITCH(8,one,two,three,four,five,six,seven,eight,nine,ten)],[@VALUE(8)])],[@VALUE(8)])] Disciples of War or Magic with a level of [@VALUE($E8(4))] or higher.
He departed the instant we received word that Nael van Darnus, Legatus of the VIIth Legion, had been sighted amongst the Garleans' ranks.

The guard will not grant you entry should you go alone, so gather a party of between [@IF($E5(4,0),[@IF($E2(4,10),[@SWITCH(4,one,two,three,four,five,six,seven,eight,nine,ten)],[@VALUE(4)])],[@VALUE(4)])] and [@IF($E5(8,0),[@IF($E2(8,10),[@SWITCH(8,one,two,three,four,five,six,seven,eight,nine,ten)],[@VALUE(8)])],[@VALUE(8)])] members. That should not prove difficult, especially for the [@IF($E9(4),daughter,son)] of a [@1A(1)]swineherd[@1A(0)]. Ahahaha!

The sigil of a Norwick knight. House Fortemps welcomes you. Ser Artoirel and his force have stormed the Darkhold in pursuit of Nael van Darnus. The last reports we received were grim, however. An enemy pincer action had seen our men surrounded, and they were able neither to press forward nor retreat.

We had heard that Nael van Darnus was a cunning leader in battle, and a gifted tactician. Should you find him, I warn you not to confront him directly. Such recklessness will only serve to make the Darkhold your tomb.

If you truly value your life, then listen carefully to my words. The depths of the Darkhold are said to contain a rift through which the creatures of the void gain entrance to this realm. And they are not all that passes through.

Foul miasmas seep into the caverns, clogging the lungs and poisoning the minds of any who linger too long. Those who have entered the hold are therefore advised to wait for a period of several suns to allow the taint to quit the body before attempting another foray.

To confirm how long you must wait before re-entering, view the Timers tab located under Attributes in the [@COLOR(#ff00cc22)][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)]main menu[@COLOR($EC)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)].

To ensure that the noisome mists are not allowed the opportunity to tighten their grip, I shall be casting a spell upon you that will teleport you back here to my side after the passing of several bells.
You can remain in the Dzemael Darkhold for a maximum of [@VALUE($E8(2))] minutes (Earth time) per visit.
In addition to the spell, you may leave the Darkhold at your leisure by returning to the entrance on foot.

Previous expedition parties reported finding what they called a magitek terminal deep in the farthest reaches of the lower chambers. It is said the device can instantly return a man to this spot, but I have found it best to take such tales with a grain of salt.

Oh, and should you come to grief down there, former visitors have confirmed that using a Return spell will transport you back to the Darkhold's entrance, so you may continue your mission, if you so wish.
And that is all the information I can give you. If I may offer an opinion, though─this is an evil place, forsaken by the Twelve and embraced by devils. Leave while you still can, and don't look back.
But seeing as you will not, the least I can do is offer you one last opportunity to make your final preparations. Speak to me once more when you are ready.

Enter the Dzemael Darkhold?
Time is of the essence. Make whatever preparations you must, but do it quickly!
I see you could not be swayed. Very well.
Your deeds have brought great honor to House Fortemps. Go now, Vairemont awaits your report at Owl's Nest.
It seems I underestimated you. Your bravery in the Darkhold brought many of our men back alive. Ser Artoirel himself saw fit to praise your deeds.

Hm? This helmet... This is [@SWITCH([@SHEET(itemData,11000266,41)],[@COLOR(#fff3f3f3)],[@COLOR(#ffc0ffa0)],[@COLOR(#ff60c8ff)],[@COLOR(#ffb38cff)],[@COLOR(#ffffa666)],[@COLOR(#ffe5dd7e)])][@EDGECOLOR(#ff262626)][@SHEETEN(xtx/itemName,1,11000266,1,1)][@EDGECOLOR($EC)][@COLOR($EC)]! The helm of a legatus! Its design is unmistakable. But that would mean...
Y-You... Twelve be good, could it be? You've slayed Nael van Darnus!

...Is no doubt what you wanted to hear. Am I not right, Ser Bumpkin? The truth of it is that scores of men have brought me countless of these false helms upon their return from the Darkhold. So many, in fact, that I am heartily sick of seeing them!

You fools from the country have much to learn. The Garleans often employ this tactic. The corpse you prized this helm from was but one of many decoys─men clad to resemble the Legatus in order to protect him. A crowd for that craven to cower behind.

Ser Artoirel, too, was vexed by this. He pursued van Darnus and his men into the Darkhold, only to be flanked by another force led by another van Darnus! Gods know how many doppelgangers the bastard has!

We have spies who have infiltrated the Empire. From their reports, we know that the Legatus is a man of great intellect, but also great cruelty and savagery. We know that he is feared among the Garleans. And yet we do not even know if he was among those we pursued into the Darkhold.

It may well be that van Darnus was simply toying with us, laughing all the while from behind the safety of Garlean lines. Yet the knights of Ishgard do not make excuses. We were bested this time around.

But we will not let ourselves be fooled again. Not by the likes of van Darnus, nor by the likes of you. Aye, Ser Bumpkin, your lies have been exposed. Another among our ranks hails from Norwick. After hearing you in passing, he claims you do not speak the region's dialect.

If it were left to me, I'd have you chained to a stone in the mountains as dragon bait. But none can deny the merit of your deeds in the Darkhold. Whatever lies you've told, you saved the lives of many of our men. It is for Ser Artoirel to decide your fate, anyway, and he has ordered you be set free. Now be gone from my sight, false knight.
Still, Nael van Darnus escaped us. It seems the Legatus is as crafty when retreating as he is when attacking.
Decoys, the whole bloody lot! And we ran headlong into their trap, as the fox after the hen! Van Darnus has made fools of us all!

I take it the deed is done? You see, we received a parcel not long ago, addressed to you care of the Flames. It contained a gold nugget and a note complimenting your incomparable valor and distinguished service...marked with no less than the seal of House Fortemps.

And lucky for us, as well. This could easily have ignited tensions between our nations. A narrow escape, indeed. Oh, I should probably mention that we've taken the liberty of exchanging your nugget for Flame Seals. Now, tell me all that you have learned.

Then it is just as we thought. The Garleans have deployed a magitek device within the Darkhold, yes, but what we must ask is why [@1A(1)]there[@1A(0)]? Of all the places in all the realm, why did they choose [@1A(1)]that[@1A(0)] precise location?

It seems to me now that the answer lies with the crystals. Dzemael Darkhold lies atop lands once prized by all the nations for their high crystal content and mining potential. The Empire must covet them for the same reasons.
Yet I cannot fathom why they should... Ceruleum is the fuel needed to drive their magitek. To what end would they crave crystals?
And if our reports are to be believed, the Legatus of the XIVth Legion has now been seen at the Darkhold as well. It appears the Empire has no intentions of losing control of it.

We will have to continue our investigations at the Darkhold to determine precisely what it is the Garleans are after. No doubt we will call on you again, [@SPLIT([@STRING($EB(1))], ,1)]. For now, though, your duty is fulfilled. Well done.

Traveling from one end of Eorzea to the other and speaking with the same accent... You must have taken leave of your bloody senses! Did you honestly think you wouldn't be discovered!? Lucky for you, your deeds spoke louder than your distinctly unconvincing words. Ser Artoirel has ordered that your crime of impersonating a knight of Ishgard be pardoned.
